subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

INCUMBENT
solution: The correct answer is: **Occupant** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Incumbent **means one that occupies a particular position or place.(पदधारी) • **Example **- *The **incumbent **store manager is not happy about having to train the person who is taking his job.* • Marked option **Occupant **means the holder of a position or office.(भोक्ता, अधिभोगी, अधिकारी) • ​**Example **- *The apartment's previous **occupant **was a painter.* • It is clear that 'Incumbent' and '**Occupant**' are **similar **in meaning. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Adventurer **means a person who enjoys or seeks adventure.(एक व्यक्ति जो रोमांच का आनंद लेता है) • **Contestant **means a person who takes part in a contest or competition.(प्रतियोगी) • **Prophet **means a person regarded as an inspired teacher or proclaimer of the will of God.(पैगम्बर, ईश्वरदूत) e2:Tbd2, The correct answer is: **I told you that you should believe her.**
